lead_summary.zh: 伊朗稱3油輪觸雷；台股週漲逾一成
lead_summary.en: Iran says 3 tankers hit mines; TAIEX up 10% on week

title.zh: 伊朗稱三油輪荷莫茲觸雷　美稱航道已清
title.en: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz; US says lanes cleared

body.zh: 伊朗海軍與革命衛隊 14 日表示，三艘油輪在荷莫茲海峽觸雷起火：其中兩艘據稱關閉雷達與定位系統、行經「未經授權」航線，在海峽南部爆炸，另一艘在海峽東側禁航區觸雷後停駛；伊方未公布船名與船籍，路透表示無法立即證實。伊朗自 2 月與美國開戰以來要求船隻須經其許可才能通過海峽，美方則封鎖伊朗港口並為過境油輪提供軍事支援，美軍表示已清除海峽主要航道的水雷。美國智庫戰爭研究所評估，伊朗的觸雷說法似在動搖外界對美軍護航的信心；另據路透取得、13 日披露的國際原子能機構機密報告，該機構對伊朗伊斯法罕一座濃縮設施的位置與狀態「愈來愈擔憂」。
body.en: Iran's navy and Revolutionary Guards said on the 14th that three oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz: two allegedly switched off radar and positioning systems and took an "unauthorised" route before exploding in the south of the strait, while a third stopped after striking a mine in a prohibited zone east of the strait; Iran did not name the vessels or their flags, and Reuters said it could not immediately verify the reports. Since war with the US broke out in February, Tehran has required ships to obtain its permission to transit, while Washington blockades Iranian ports, gives military support to tankers and says it has cleared the main shipping lanes of mines. The US-based Institute for the Study of War assessed that Iran's mine claims appear aimed at undermining confidence in US naval escorts; separately, a confidential IAEA report obtained by Reuters and disclosed on the 13th said the agency is increasingly concerned about the location and status of an enrichment facility at Isfahan.

title.zh: 美提新歐安框架　澤倫斯基憂利普丁
title.en: Zelensky warns US-floated European security plan could help Putin

body.zh: 美聯社 14 日報導，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基表示，美方在推動結束戰爭時提出建立新的歐洲安全框架，他認為此構想「危險」，俄方可能藉此削弱北約並改變歐洲邊界，不應成為談判主軸。他說美方曾詢問若烏克蘭加入北約，是否願意撤出俄軍尚未控制的頓巴斯地區，烏方不會讓出領土、也拒絕中立，並主張先停火、再終戰、後談安全保障。克宮發言人佩斯科夫則說，俄方對歐洲參與談判持開放態度，會接受歐洲派出的任何代表。戰場上，烏軍參謀本部稱擊中俄國薩馬拉一處輸油站與利佩茨克-2 機場，莫斯科未回應；烏方緊急救難單位則說，俄軍 13 日攻擊札波羅熱造成 22 人受傷。
body.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said, according to an AP report on the 14th, that the US had raised a possible new European security framework as part of efforts to end the war; he called the idea dangerous, warning Moscow could use it to weaken NATO and redraw borders, and said it should not be the main agenda. He said the US had asked whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of Donbas that Russia does not control if Kyiv joined NATO; Ukraine will not give up territory and rejects neutrality, and he said the order should be a ceasefire, then an end to the war, then security guarantees. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Moscow is open to European participation in the talks and would accept whatever representatives Europe sends. On the battlefield, Ukraine's General Staff said it hit an oil pumping station in Russia's Samara region and the Lipetsk-2 airfield, with no comment from Moscow, while Ukraine's emergency service said a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia on the 13th injured 22 people.

title.zh: 微軟服務全球中斷近一天　已全面恢復
title.en: Microsoft restores services after near day-long global outage

body.zh: 微軟旗下 Microsoft 365、Outlook、Teams、Copilot 與 Exchange Online 自週四（12 日）格林威治時間 17 時 54 分起陸續故障，波及逾 70 個國家，週五下午才逐步恢復，微軟週六清晨表示根本問題已處理。受影響者包括日本政府、菲律賓最高法院、加拿大國鐵、北美的醫院與法院，以及英國部分學校、警察機關與國民保健署；英國主管網路安全的部長表示，對 999 緊急電話等前線服務的影響有限。微軟說問題源於一次「網路容量升級」，並非網路攻擊或 AI 代理造成，已向客戶致歉，並將在檢討完成後公布完整事故報告。
body.en: Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, Copilot and Exchange Online began failing from 17:54 GMT on Thursday (the 12th), affecting more than 70 countries before services gradually recovered on Friday afternoon; early on Saturday Microsoft said the underlying problem had been addressed. Those hit included the Japanese government, the Philippine Supreme Court, Canada's national rail operator, hospitals and courts in North America, and some UK schools, police forces and parts of the NHS; the UK minister responsible for cyber security said the impact on frontline services such as 999 calls was limited. Microsoft said the problem was introduced during a network capacity upgrade and was not caused by a cyber-attack or an AI agent; it apologised to customers and will publish a full post-incident report after its review.

title.zh: 德國國會通過情報改革　BND可主動反制
title.en: German parliament gives spy agencies power to actively disrupt threats

body.zh: 德國聯邦議院 13 日以 308 票贊成、190 票反對、71 票棄權，通過擴大聯邦情報局（BND）與聯邦憲法保衛局（BfV）權限的改革法案，執政的基民盟與社民黨支持，另類選擇黨與左派黨反對。新法讓兩機構不只蒐集情報，也可主動干擾威脅，例如由 BfV 刪除攻擊者伺服器上的竊取資料，BND 則可在境外干擾國家支持駭客所用的伺服器。內政部長多布林特稱這是「世紀改革」，讓德國情報機構與歐洲夥伴站上同等地位；左派黨則認為部分條款不符憲法對侵入式監控的標準，恐形同設立秘密警察。主要條文預定 12 月 31 日生效，仍待完成立法程序。
body.en: Germany's Bundestag voted 308 to 190, with 71 abstentions, on the 13th to pass a reform expanding the powers of the foreign intelligence service (BND) and the domestic intelligence agency (BfV), backed by the governing Christian Democrats and Social Democrats and opposed by the AfD and the Left Party. The law lets both agencies actively disrupt threats rather than only gather information, for example by having the BfV delete stolen data from an attacker's server and allowing the BND to disrupt servers used by state-backed hackers abroad. Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt called it a reform of the century that puts German agencies on an equal footing with European partners, while the Left Party argued key provisions fail constitutional standards for intrusive surveillance and risk creating a secret police. The main provisions are due to take effect on December 31, pending completion of the legislative process.

title.zh: 教宗良十四世訪秘魯　晤神職性侵倖存者
title.en: Pope Leo meets clergy abuse survivors in Peru

body.zh: 教宗良十四世 12 日在秘魯利馬的教廷大使館，與 6 名遭神職人員及教會機構成員侵害的倖存者會面逾一小時，其中部分人曾屬於與「基督生活會」（Sodalitium Christianae Vitae）相關的團體，該平信徒組織已於 2025 年遭教宗方濟各解散。教廷新聞室表示，教宗與倖存者討論如何透過傾聽受害者促成心態轉變，並尋求真相、支持療癒與建立安全環境。教宗在與秘魯主教會面時表示，神職人員性侵造成巨大傷痛，教會必須以真相、正義、寬恕與補償回應；他過去曾任秘魯奇克拉約教區主教。
body.en: Pope Leo XIV met six survivors of abuse by clergy and members of church institutions for more than an hour at the Apostolic Nunciature in Lima on the 12th; some had belonged to groups linked to Sodalitium Christianae Vitae, a lay movement Pope Francis suppressed in 2025. The Holy See Press Office said they discussed how to foster a change of mindset by listening to victims, as well as seeking the truth, supporting healing and creating safe environments. Meeting Peru's bishops, the pope said clergy abuse has caused great pain and the Church must respond with truth, justice, forgiveness and amends; he previously served as bishop of Chiclayo in Peru.

title.zh: 輝達單週跌12.75%　17日財報成焦點
title.en: Nvidia falls 12.75% in a week ahead of Nov 17 results

body.zh: 輝達股價 13 日收跌約 2%，單週累計下跌 12.75%，連續第六週走低；公司將於美國時間 17 日公布截至 10 月的季度財報，這是黃仁勳 12 日辭去執行長、由財務長柯蕾絲暫代後的首份財報。鉅亨網引述 MarketWatch 指出，市場將關注財報內容、截至 9 月底尚餘約 2,350 億美元的庫藏股授權，以及執行長接班安排。經濟日報報導，川普曾點名庫克接任，但分析師認為機率極低；另傳部分台灣伺服器業者擔憂美方加強出口管制，已主動加強查核客戶與出貨地點。
body.en: Nvidia closed down about 2% on the 13th, leaving it 12.75% lower for the week and down for a sixth straight week; it reports results for the quarter ended in October on the 17th, US time, its first report since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on the 12th and CFO Colette Kress became interim chief. Citing MarketWatch, Anue said investors will watch the results, roughly $235 billion of remaining buyback authorisation as of late September, and CEO succession. Economic Daily News reported that Donald Trump had floated Tim Cook for the job, though analysts see little chance of that, and that some Taiwanese server makers, wary of tighter US export controls, have reportedly stepped up checks on customers and shipping destinations.

title.zh: Anthropic下週掛牌　估值1.4兆美元
title.en: Anthropic set to list next week at about $1.4 trillion valuation

body.zh: 據 Yahoo 財經報導，AI 公司 Anthropic 首次公開發行的價格區間為每股 70 至 78 美元，發行 8.25 億股，估值約 1.4 兆美元，預計美國時間 18 日定價、19 日在那斯達克以代號 ANT 掛牌交易。報導指出，輝達、微軟、Google 等大型科技公司另將以 IPO 價格認購無投票權的 N 類股，金額約 260 億美元。該公司截至 9 月 30 日的前九個月營收約 332 億美元、年增約 1,206%，營業虧損由去年同期的 52 億美元收窄至 13 億美元。
body.en: Yahoo Finance reported that AI company Anthropic has set a price range of $70 to $78 a share for its initial public offering of 825 million shares, valuing it at roughly $1.4 trillion, with pricing expected on the 18th, US time, and trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT from the 19th. Large tech companies including Nvidia, Microsoft and Google will separately buy about $26 billion of non-voting Class N shares at the IPO price, the report said. Revenue for the nine months to September 30 rose about 1,206% to $33.2 billion, while the operating loss narrowed to $1.3 billion from $5.2 billion a year earlier.

title.zh: 台積電美國廠前三季賺近540億　年增逾十倍
title.en: TSMC Arizona's nine-month profit jumps more than tenfold

body.zh: 經濟日報依台積電 13 日上傳的財報電子書報導，美國子公司 TSMC Arizona 前三季獲利新台幣 539.86 億元，創歷史新高，較去年同期的 47.69 億元成長逾十倍，台積電認列的投資利益為 485.58 億元。日本熊本的 JASM 前三季獲利 23.96 億元，去年同期為虧損 62.22 億元；德國德勒斯登的 ESMC 則仍虧損，前三季累計約 10.79 億元。台積電前三季另獲美、德、日、中等地政府補助約 1,675.9 億元。
body.en: Citing the full financial report TSMC uploaded on the 13th, Economic Daily News said US subsidiary TSMC Arizona earned a record NT$53.986 billion in the first three quarters, more than ten times the NT$4.769 billion of a year earlier, with TSMC booking an investment gain of NT$48.558 billion. JASM in Kumamoto, Japan, earned NT$2.396 billion versus a loss of NT$6.222 billion a year earlier, while ESMC in Dresden, Germany, remained loss-making at about NT$1.079 billion for the period. TSMC also received about NT$167.59 billion in government subsidies in the US, Germany, Japan and China over the nine months.

title.zh: 油價連兩週下跌　供給過剩疑慮升溫
title.en: Oil posts second weekly drop on supply-glut worries

body.zh: 國際油價 13 日漲跌互見，布蘭特原油收每桶 95.84 美元、微漲 0.02%，西德州原油收 88.56 美元、跌 0.20%，兩者本週皆跌約 2.5%，為連續第二週下跌；前一週布蘭特與西德州分別重挫 16% 與 13%。國際能源總署報告指出全球石油供給過剩擴大，美國能源資訊署則顯示原油與燃料庫存增加，透露美國需求轉弱。不過美國持續封鎖伊朗、荷莫茲海峽油輪遇襲，以及葉門胡塞組織攻擊沙烏地設施等消息，仍讓供給風險未消。
body.en: Oil prices were mixed on the 13th, with Brent settling up 0.02% at $95.84 a barrel and WTI down 0.20% at $88.56; both fell about 2.5% for the week, a second straight weekly decline after Brent slumped 16% and WTI 13% the week before. An International Energy Agency report pointed to a growing global supply surplus, and Energy Information Administration data showed rising US crude and fuel inventories, signalling softer domestic demand. Supply risks remained, however, as the US kept up its blockade of Iran and reports continued of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and of Houthi strikes on Saudi facilities.

title.zh: 產假延長至14週　育兒新制拚元旦上路
title.en: Taiwan extends maternity leave to 14 weeks from 2027

body.zh: 立法院 13 日三讀通過《性別平等工作法》與《就業保險法》修正案，產假由 8 週延長為 14 週，陪產檢及陪產假由 7 日增為 14 日；育嬰留職停薪更名為育兒留職停薪，適用對象由子女未滿 3 歲放寬至未滿 9 歲，可按日申請的育兒假增為 60 日。雙親若各領滿 6 個月津貼可再各領 3 個月，合計最長 18 個月，津貼維持投保薪資 6 成，另由公務預算加給 2 成、合計 8 成。雇主可就新增假期依法應付的薪資向政府申請補貼；兩案須經總統公布，預計最快 2027 年元旦上路。
body.en: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan on the 13th passed amendments to the Gender Equality in Employment Act and the Employment Insurance Act, extending maternity leave from eight to 14 weeks and prenatal-checkup and paternity leave from seven to 14 days; parental leave without pay will cover children up to age 8 instead of under 3, and day-by-day childcare leave rises to 60 days. Each parent who takes six months of benefits can claim three more, for a combined maximum of 18 months, with benefits kept at 60% of insured salary plus a 20% top-up from the government budget, for 80% in total. Employers can apply for government subsidies for wages owed during the added leave; the bills await presidential promulgation and could take effect as early as January 1, 2027.

headline.zh: 台股週漲3,973點　單週漲幅10.01%
headline.en: TAIEX gains 3,973 points, up 10.01% on the week

body.zh: 加權指數 13 日終場上漲 583.25 點、收 43,675.12 點，漲幅 1.35%，盤中最高 44,489.48 點、最低 43,534.12 點，成交值 9,162.55 億元；櫃買指數收 342.41 點、漲 6.68 點（1.99%）。本週（11/9–11/13）加權指數由 39,701.64 點升至 43,675.12 點，累計上漲 3,973.48 點、漲幅 10.01%，鉅亨網引述富蘭克林證券投顧指出為本週亞洲表現最強市場，主要動能之一是台積電 10 月營收約 5,868.9 億元、年增 59.7%，創單月新高。13 日台積電漲 10 元、收 2,350 元，聯發科漲 270 元至 4,120 元；三大法人合計買超 439.65 億元，其中外資買超 288.36 億元，結束連續 11 個交易日賣超。
body.en: The TAIEX closed up 583.25 points, or 1.35%, at 43,675.12 on the 13th, after trading between 44,489.48 and 43,534.12, with turnover of NT$916.26 billion; the TPEx index closed at 342.41, up 6.68 points or 1.99%. For the week of November 9-13 the TAIEX rose from 39,701.64 to 43,675.12, a gain of 3,973.48 points or 10.01%, which Anue, citing Franklin Securities Investment Consulting, said made it Asia's best-performing market, helped by TSMC's record October revenue of about NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% from a year earlier. On the 13th TSMC rose NT$10 to NT$2,350 and MediaTek gained NT$270 to NT$4,120; the three major institutional groups bought a net NT$43.965 billion, including NT$28.836 billion from foreign investors, ending an 11-session foreign selling streak.

flows_note.zh: 外資（含陸資）買超 288.36 億元，終止連續 11 個交易日賣超；三大法人同步買超。
flows_note.en: Foreign (incl. mainland) investors bought a net NT$28.836 billion, ending an 11-session selling streak; all three groups were net buyers.

headline.zh: 美股：費半挫3.43%　三大指數週線收高
headline.en: US close, Nov 13: SOX sinks 3.43%; major indexes up for week

body.zh: 週五（13 日）美股晶片股遭賣壓，道瓊小漲 0.10%、收 52,347.55 點，為唯一收紅的主要指數，標普 500 跌 0.40%、收 7,561.67 點，那指跌 0.91%、收 25,136.27 點，費城半導體指數重挫 3.43%；台積電 ADR 跌 1.69%、收 398.63 美元。輝達收跌約 2%，週線累計下跌 12.75%，市場聚焦黃仁勳去職後的接班與下週二財報，前一日大漲的超微重挫 8.75%。10 年期美債殖利率約 5.15%，加上 Anthropic 即將上市，促使投資人重新評估 AI 類股評價；以週線計，標普 500 仍上漲約 2.51%、那指漲 2.27%、道瓊漲 2.07%。
body.en: On Friday, November 13, chip stocks came under selling pressure: the Dow edged up 0.10% to 52,347.55, the only major index to finish higher, while the S&P 500 fell 0.40% to 7,561.67, the Nasdaq 0.91% to 25,136.27 and the SOX 3.43%; the TSMC ADR lost 1.69% to US$398.63. Nvidia closed down about 2% for a weekly loss of 12.75% as investors focused on succession after Jensen Huang's exit and its results due Tuesday, and AMD, which had rallied the day before, sank 8.75%. A 10-year Treasury yield near 5.15% and Anthropic's upcoming listing led investors to reassess AI valuations; for the week, the S&P 500 still gained about 2.51%, the Nasdaq 2.27% and the Dow 2.07%.
